svg.title: Sympozium primitives and their relationships
svg.desc: CRD primitives and how they interconnect: an Ensemble stamps out Agents and SympoziumSchedules; an Agent references an AgentRuntime, SkillPacks, MCPServers, a Model and a SympoziumPolicy; schedules create AgentRuns; an AgentRun references its Agent, runtime, Model, borrowed CellnTools and child AgentRunTurns; HarnessSession and WorkspaceSession bind an Agent to a runtime; CellnToolSubmissions are reviewed into CellnTools; the controller reconciles primitives and the admission webhook enforces policy.
